team.abilityDesc: Prevents Steel-type Pokémon from fleeing by pulling them in with magnetism. The Pokémon also draws in all the opponent's Steel-type moves.

moves.name: Thunder Shock
moves.desc: The user attacks the target with a jolt of electricity. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Sonic Boom
moves.desc: The target is hit with a destructive shock wave. It inflicts damage equal to the user's level.
mechanics: Inflige daño fijo igual al nivel del usuario

moves.name: Spark
moves.desc: The user attacks the target with an electrically charged tackle. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Magnet Bomb
moves.desc: The user launches steel bombs that stick to the target. This attack never misses.
